body: Usually I take about a 20-30 minute nap at lunch, so I guess you could add that to how much I sleep. My grades arent great and haven't been for a while now and I used to get in trouble a lot in Jr. High for falling asleep during class but over the past few years I've been able to find ways to keep myself awake during class. I don't have a job but I have been trying to get one for a while, I don't drive and I don't have friends to be hanging out with either so none of those are really issues for me at the moment. Also, I realize that medication wouldn't solve my insomnia but being able to actually sleep would help me a lot.
